title: Dictation playground walkthrough: Next / Next through the real pipeline

set.request: Build the Next/Next walkthrough of the dictation playground: one small screen per step, a real screenshot, one sentence, a link to open it live. Brief: public/framework/ai/2026-09-28/dictation-playground/walkthrough/requirements.md
set.now: smoke.mjs clean on both pages; writing docs and landing
steps: Read the brief and the landed playground code (Playground.js, page.js, tidy.js)
Write a Playwright script to shoot each of the 6 steps at 1920x1080, driving $dictate_pg for the meter/sample/tidy steps
Write walkthrough/page.js copying ai2-lead's Wizard shape

Hold reload, write files, load the page, release the hold

- [x] Where it is: shot from the rail, UX -> Dictate, playground at the top
- [x] Audio source: mic picker + a level meter shown moving (driven to 0.6 through $dictate_pg)
- [x] Raw Whisper: two settled lines, a paragraph-break line, the grey still-guessing line last
- [x] Corrections: the REAL fast assistant (claude-sonnet-5, not the rules fallback) — 'so um i was thinking we should uh we should build the the playground' -> 'So I was thinking we should build the playground.' (3.2s); status line reads 'cleanup: fast assistant · claude-sonnet-5 · 3.2 s'
- [x] Live: two shots of the same real correction ('what do you think? about the the layout' -> 'What do you think about the layout?') — mid-fade at 2s, clean at 6s
- [x] Later: notes the structured-content pass is deferred to card 2026/09/28/structured-content-icon-cards-outlines-b, reusing the Live tab's clean-text shot
- [x] smoke.mjs clean on both pages, zero console/request errors on load

**Left alone:** no Server/review.mjs fresh-eyes pass — this task has no worktree or branch (the brief has it landing straight in the shared main tree, already on michael/dev with a large pre-existing uncommitted diff from other work), so the script's `git diff michael/dev...<branch>` has nothing meaningful to diff; verified instead by the smoke test, four screenshots read back against the brief's own sentence, and three headless checks of the file/console/health state before and after every write.
